description: 80-dps first-principles evaluation of coordinate-verified 3D compact-ball simplicial manifold triangulations (M, dM ~= S^2), Dehn-Sommerville interior edge-cycle closure (c = f_3 - (A - 3)), buried interior nucleon shells (A_int = A - A_bdry), O(A^{2/3}) surface-to-volume scaling, and (Z, N) Pauli/Fermi kinetic promotion across 15 benchmark nuclei (2H to 238U). Evaluates all three parameter-free 2-body bond channels (b2_log_D, b2_Bor_D, b2_log_gg) with H_3/H_4 GPMT cumulants (w3_GPMT, w4_GPMT_H4) at both bare E0 and tower-resummed E0 across both proton and muon q0 anchors. Zero free parameters, zero fitting, zero float64 intermediates.
q0AnchorReason: Evaluates 3D compact-ball simplicial manifold triangulation binding energies across both the physical proton pin and ideal muon pin for cross-anchor comparison.
